answer: I put Harvestkeeper harvest proof entered in the harvest tally first because 3-year cellar service, 130 supervised pressings, cellar exam, annual tally dues is the kind of cost a farm cannot borrow its way around. Faking 429 identities means 429 fresh proofs and 101 POA each, while the honest path costs one proof and 18 minutes. Follow the grove back to the office that issued it, follow the inlet back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the echo back to the year it was filed. One credential, honestly earned, outweighs a thousand printed at midnight.
